ja267:1.1: Siṅgī migo āyatacakkhunetto aṭṭhittaco vārisayo alomo, tenābhibhūto kapaṇaṃ rudāmi, mā heva maṃ pāṇasamaṃ jaheyyā ti.
ja267:2.1: Ayya na taṃ jahissāmi kuñjara saṭṭhihāyana, pathavyā cāturantāya suppiyo hosi me tuvan ti.
ja267:3.1: Ye kulīrā samuddasmiṃ Gaṅgāya Nammadāya ca tesaṃ tvaṃ vārijo seṭṭho, muñca rodantiyā patin ti.
